blocks.en: The first tool that we will develop for deriving the existence theory for elliptic equations is commonly known as the Lax-Milgram lemma; though because of its importance we designate it as a theorem. The result is simply a generalization of the Riesz Representation Theorem (Theorem~\ref{thm:hilbert-riesz-representation}) to bilinear forms that need not be symmetric.
blocks.zh: 为建立椭圆方程的存在性理论而发展的第一个工具通常称为 Lax-Milgram 引理; 不过由于它的重要性, 将其列为定理. 这一结果只是将 Riesz 表示定理 (Theorem~\ref{thm:hilbert-riesz-representation}) 推广到不一定对称的双线性型.

blocks.en: A mapping $B$ satisfying \eqref{eq:lax-milgram-bilinear-coercivity} for some $c_2>0$ is called \textbf{coercive}. The inequality \eqref{eq:lax-milgram-bilinear-coercivity} can be thought of as an energy estimate. (The inequality says that the energy (the norm squared) can only blow up as fast as the bilinear form.)
blocks.zh: 若映射 $B$ 以某个 $c_2>0$ 满足 \eqref{eq:lax-milgram-bilinear-coercivity}, 则称其为\textbf{强制的}. 不等式 \eqref{eq:lax-milgram-bilinear-coercivity} 可看作能量估计. (该不等式说明, 能量 (范数的平方) 的增长速度最多与双线性型一样快.)
